item.description:

Hello everyone! The version of ContraZ on GameMaps had been left abandoned and outdated at v0.5, while the Steam version continued to evolve. I’m happy to announce that I’ve worked on and modified the campaign to bring the **latest version (v0.7)** directly here—fully ready for you to enjoy. Furthermore, I will be providing **ongoing support** and updates to ensure the best possible gameplay experience. Enjoy this release, inspired by *Contra*, and please don’t hesitate to leave your feedback or report any issues!

item.title: [ Mod ] Boticuy Survivor Pack (Coach Replacement)
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 5
Description Boticuy Survivor Pack is a custom character and item replacement pack for Left 4 Dead 2, developed by Galy Studio in collaboration with Boticuy, a Peruvian online health and pharmacy brand. The pack replaces Coach with Boticuy, featuring a custom 3D model based on the original mascot, optimized geometry, custom textures, rigging, HUD icons, and a Boomer bile effect. It also includes a personalized First Aid Kit and Oramin-F as a replacement for Pain Pills. This addon was created as a free collaboration to bring Boticuy into the zombie apocalypse while preserving the original gameplay experience. Compatibility This addon may conflict with other mods that replace Coach, First Aid Kits, or Pain Pills. Disable conflicting addons before playing.
